decision.reason: The frozen campaign has not run on the exact target; arithmetic evidence from issue 8623 cannot establish broad quality.
rollback_criteria: Any promoted family falls below 0.95 pass rate in a repeated exact-target campaign.
The Wilson lower bound falls below 0.80.
The no-thinking arm loses more than 0.05 pass-rate points versus thinking.
decision.promotion_evidence: A complete paired exact-target run whose family rows clear every quality gate.
decision.demotion_or_retirement_evidence: A failed family gate, environment mismatch, incomplete raw streams, or validator drift retains or restores thinking.
decision.invalidating_assumption: These deterministic representative tasks predict the operator task families named by the issue.
